name: Nazara Technologies Ltd
title: Nazara Technologies Ltd - 543280 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: Nazara FY26 EBITDA rose 66% to INR 255 crore, with Q4 EBITDA margin at 19.5%, helped by a one-time INR 31 crore Rusk Media gain.
summary.overview: FY26 revenue was INR 1,829 crore (up 13% YoY) and EBITDA INR 255 crore (up 66%), a record, with EBITDA margin at 13.9%. Q4 revenue was INR 398 crore and EBITDA INR 78 crore (19.5% margin). Gaming rose to 90% of EBITDA in FY26 from 56% in FY25. Bluetile and BestPlay acquisition was completed in the quarter but will be consolidated only from Q1 FY27, pending Spanish FDI approval expected in 3-4 weeks. Management guided to growth in revenue and EBITDA for FY27 without numerical guidance.

segments.name: Mobile gaming
segments.commentary: FY26 revenue INR 713 crore (+38%) and EBITDA INR 137 crore (+33%), driven by LiveOps, user acquisition and data analytics under the COE model. Kiddopia returned to subscriber growth in Q3 and continued in Q4; Animal Jam expanded margins.

segments.name: PC and console publishing (Curve Games, Fusebox, Human Fall Flat)
segments.commentary: FY26 revenue INR 261 crore and EBITDA INR 101 crore (39% margin). Human Fall Flat crossed 58 million lifetime units. Analyst noted revenue growth was hardly visible YoY; management said the company had a low signing period before the acquisition.

segments.name: Offline gaming (Smaaash, Funky Monkeys)
segments.commentary: FY26 revenue INR 99 crore and EBITDA INR 27 crore, profitable in the year. Funky Monkeys footprint expanding; Smaaash 2.0 format in progress.

segments.name: AdTech (DataWrkz, Space and Time)
segments.commentary: Revenue and EBITDA each grew 32% YoY in FY26, but Q4 revenue declined sequentially, which management attributed to exiting traditional adtech and UK new-homes market weakness.

segments.name: Sportskeeda
segments.commentary: Remained profitable in FY26 despite Google Core update traffic losses; analyst cited revenue down about 38% in FY26. Management expects margin improvement in FY27 on a smaller base.

segments.name: NODWIN (associate)
segments.commentary: EBITDA swung to INR 21 crore profit in FY26 from INR 14 crore loss in FY25. Q4 associate losses included a INR 50 crore goodwill write-off on OML assets, mainly NH7 Weekender. Planning to raise USD 100-200 million and an independent IPO.

guidance_outlook: No numerical guidance; management expects growth in both revenue and EBITDA in FY27, with operating leverage from COEs and AI.

Bluetile consolidation from Q1 FY27 once Spanish FDI approval is received (expected in 3-4 weeks). Management said pro forma EBITDA would at least double if combined with Bluetile's CY25 EBITDA of INR 254 crore.
Curve Games expects at least 6 new releases in FY27, maybe more; margin target of 50% on signed games.
Fusebox plans three Big Brother seasons and a Traitors launch in FY27, plus three new Love Island seasons.
Non-core divestments (NODWIN, Sportskeeda or adtech) possible in FY27-FY28; management said there is no rush.
Sportskeeda margins expected to increase in FY27 on a smaller revenue base.
capex_capacity: Bluetile and BestPlay acquisition completed in the quarter; consolidation from Q1 FY27 pending Spanish FDI approval.
Curve Games plans to increase development spend to build its release pipeline.
Smaaash 2.0 re-imagined format in progress; Funky Monkeys footprint expanding.
Animal Jam: first Mattel Monster High IP integration launched in Q1 FY27; Roblox native experience planned; a new hyper-casual game for kids and women in North America is due in Q2 FY27.
demand_pricing: Bluetile operates in casual evergreen (solitaire, word games, board and puzzle games) and hybrid casual. Management cited Triple Dot (valued over USD 1 billion) and Easybrain (acquired by Miniclip for about USD 1 billion) as comparables.
Management said platform commissions (Google, Apple at 30%) are coming down over time, which should aid margins.
Adtech decline reflects a deliberate shift from traditional adtech to the DSP product Vizibl; UK new-homes market weakness hit Space and Time's Q4 discretionary spend.
Fusebox revenue is seasonal; Q3 FY26 fell about 49% QoQ before recovering in Q4.

qa_highlights.question: What drove the INR 51 crore other income and what explains the NODWIN associate loss of about INR 31 crore?
qa_highlights.answer: Other income included a one-time INR 31 crore gain on Rusk Media from a revaluation after its new funding round, plus currency gains on loans to Nazara UK and mutual fund gains. The associate loss reflected a INR 50 crore NODWIN goodwill write-off on OML assets and Moonshine losses.

qa_highlights.question: Is Sportskeeda's decline recoverable, or should margins be modelled at 12-15%?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said recovery has not yet come through; the focus in FY26 was protecting EBITDA over revenue. Cost optimisation continues and margins are expected to rise in FY27 on a smaller base. Pro Football Network and PrimeTimer are showing positive signs.

qa_highlights.question: What is the NODWIN fundraising and IPO plan, and will Nazara monetise its stake?
qa_highlights.answer: NODWIN plans to raise USD 100-200 million, a mix of primary and secondary, and prepare an independent IPO as soon as timing is right. Nazara will consider monetising non-core assets (NODWIN, Sportskeeda or adtech) but is in no hurry.

qa_highlights.question: What is Bluetile's TAM and scalability, and what is the FY27 growth and margin outlook post consolidation?
qa_highlights.answer: Bluetile's casual evergreen and hybrid casual segments were described as large and profitable with global reach. Management gave no specific guidance but pointed to Bluetile CY25 revenue of INR 1,460 crore and EBITDA of INR 254 crore, with combined EBITDA at least doubling pro forma.

qa_highlights.question: Why did adtech revenue decline sequentially in Q4, and is it temporary?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the decline was partly deliberate, exiting traditional adtech, and partly UK new-homes market weakness hitting Space and Time. Space and Time finished FY26 ahead of AOP and management expects FY27 growth.

qa_highlights.question: Can Curve Games margins hold above 30-35% as Switch 2 launches scale, and when will Bluetile consolidate?
qa_highlights.answer: Curve targets 50% margin on signed games and expects margins to hold. Bluetile is expected to close after Spanish FDI approval in 3-4 weeks and consolidate from Q1 FY27.

risks_watch: Q4 other income (INR 51 crore) includes a one-time INR 31 crore Rusk Media gain; underlying earnings are lower.
Sportskeeda is still hit by Google Core update traffic losses; FY26 revenue fell about 38% per analyst.
PC and console publishing revenue was almost flat in FY26 at INR 261 crore; Curve's new-release pipeline must convert.
Bluetile consolidation depends on Spanish FDI approval timing; deal must close before FY27 numbers are included.
Fusebox seasonality remains; Q3 FY26 saw about 49% QoQ decline.
AdTech revenue declined sequentially in Q4 FY26, with UK new-homes weakness.
Monetisation of non-core assets and NODWIN's independent IPO have no set timelines.
summary.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on gaming scale, COE-driven margins and FY27 growth, but evasive on numbers, giving no formal guidance. Cautious on Sportskeeda and adtech, where management attributed declines to temporary or strategic factors and said recovery has not yet arrived.
key_quotes: FY '26 was a pivotal year for Na zara. Revenue reached INR 1,829 crores and EBITDA grew 66% to INR 255 crores, our highest ever, with Q4 EBITDA margins reaching 19.5%, - almost doubling on a year -on-year basis.

Gaming contribution to EBITDA increased from 56% in FY '25 to 90% in FY '26, as we strengthened our focus on building a high -margin, globally diversified gaming platform across mobile, PC, and console, and offline gaming.
I do believe our operating leverage is real, and it is now starting to compound.
The other income is predominantly driven by a one-time gain of INR 31 crores on our investment in Rusk Media.
Our margin target is always 50% on any game that we sign.

It's still pending the Spanish FDI approval, which is in process. And we expect to close the acquisition as soon as that comes in. At this point of time, we are expecting it to come in in the next few weeks, I think 3-4 weeks.

adds.what: Bluetile acquisition (casual evergreen and hybrid casual games) consolidated from Q1 FY27 pending Spanish FDI approval; not a capacity build

growth.why: Management gave no numerical FY27 guidance but said it is 'very bullish' on revenue and EBITDA growth, backed by Bluetile consolidation from Q1 FY27 (pro forma EBITDA at least doubling vs CY25 INR 254 crore), Curve Games' 6+ releases, and Fusebox seasons, with support only partly specified.
